mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate indicates accommodative monetary policy, which stimulates economic growth and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not higher when FEDFUNDS is low, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Rising unemployment rate indicates economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days when UNRATE crosses above 7%.
failure_condition: SPX returns positive >60% when UNRATE >7%, or Rank IC <0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rises and consumer spending falls, negative economic outlook leads to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: Positive returns despite UNRATE up and RSAFS down, or Rank IC <0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth during expansion signals strong supply, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: Negative returns with INDPRO growth, or Rank IC <0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Growth in payroll employment indicates a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: Negative returns with PAYEMS growth, or Rank IC <0.03.

mechanism_narrative: GDP growth above 3% indicates strong demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: Negative returns with GDPC1 >3%, or Rank IC <0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Low FEDFUNDS and high UNRATE indicate economic stress, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: Positive returns with low FEDFUNDS and high UNRATE, or Rank IC <0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts growth during expansion indicates strong demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: Negative returns with HOUST growth, or Rank IC <0.03.
